topic:
Boi canh: repo task-manager (D:\coding\personal-tools\task-manager), nhanh security-fixes-arch-review
(tach tu main, sach ngoai 2 commit fix bao mat MindMap da lam xong o buoc truoc). Council vua ra soat
kien truc (run a24496ba) phat hien: cac truong actionType (gia tri post/drive/redmine)/aiNote/relatedIds
tren tasks + release_task_definitions + emergency_release_task_definitions VAN CON NGUYEN sau khi CR
truoc (CR-20260912-xoa-ai-automation-tai-cau-truc) da xoa het AI automation - UI van hien "AI xu ly",
"Mo ta cho AI", canh bao "hay chon Drive/Redmine truoc khi chay AI" du KHONG CON AI NAO CHAY DUOC NUA.
Leader da quyet dinh: XOA HAN ca 3 truong (khong phai chi doi nhan).

Khi tu doc code (khong doan), phat hien 2 rang buoc quan trong CHUA duoc bao voi Leader luc hoi:

1. `server/lib/release-render.ts` ham `diffTaskAgainstDefinition()` (dong 235-249) va
   `buildReleaseUpdateStatement()` (dong 255+) dang dung CA actionType LAN aiNote nhu 2 trong 8 truong
   de phat hien "task lech definition goc" (tinh nang FR-5/FR-6 tu CR-20260814-hop-nhat, TUNG SUA 1 BUG
   THAT - BUG-20260814: AI dang bai bang ai_note ban cu 374 ky tu trong khi definition da la 1005 ky tu,
   khong ai phat hien vi khong co canh bao lech). Neu xoa actionType/aiNote khoi bang, phai xoa 2 dong
   so sanh nay khoi `diffTaskAgainstDefinition`/`buildReleaseUpdateStatement` - tinh nang "lech
   definition" (badge canh bao + dong bo) se CHi CON SO 6/8 TRUONG (tenTask, ghiChu, gioBatDau,
   ngayCuThe, links, replyToRef), mat kha nang bao dong khi note/loai hanh dong bi lech. Leader da CHAP
   NHAN mat pham vi nay (da xac nhan qua cau hoi truoc khi mo phien nay) - KHONG can ban lai quyet dinh
   nay, chi can thuc thi dung.

2. `relatedIds` tren RELEASE DEFINITION (khac relatedIds tren TASK thuong - 2 cho dung khac muc dich)
   dang la NGUON DU LIEU DE FE (`src/screens/release.tsx` dong 426, 516, 549) tu tinh
   `replyToRef: (definition.relatedIds || []).map(String).find(Boolean) || null` luc tao task tu
   definition. `replyToRef`/`origin_ref` la du lieu nghiep vu THAT da duoc xac nhan GIU LAI tu CR truoc
   (khong lien quan AI) - dung de "map comment<->post ben qua cac dot" (task moi phai comment/reply vao
   dung bai cu nao). Neu xoa relatedIds khoi release_task_definitions, MAT LUON nguon du lieu duy nhat
   dang dung de tinh replyToRef cho task moi tao tu definition. Leader da CHAP NHAN can thiet ke lai
   nguon du lieu nay (da xac nhan qua cau hoi truoc khi mo phien nay).

   relatedIds tren TASK THUONG (khac voi tren definition) hien la 1 picker UI "Task lien quan" hien thi
   trong AutomationFieldsEditor, CHi HIEN KHI actionType != none (xem comment dong 92
   automation-fields.tsx: "aiNote + relatedIds chi hien khi actionType != none") - day la UI gating
   nhan tao, KHONG co bang chung du lieu nay duoc dung lam gi khac ngoai hien thi/luu tru (chua tim thay
   consumer nao doc lai relatedIds cua TASK thuong de tinh toan gi). Neu xoa, chi mat 1 UI picker chua
   ro gia tri thuc te, khong anh huong tinh nang nao khac da xac nhan.

YEU CAU CU THE CHO COUNCIL (day la PHIEN THIET KE, khong phai review - Council PHAI tu doc code that
truoc khi de xuat, khong duoc doan):

1. Xac nhan lai (doc code that, khong tin loi ke tren) 2 rang buoc tren co dung khong - dac biet
   phan biet ro relatedIds tren TASK (co the xoa an toan) voi relatedIds tren RELEASE/EMERGENCY
   DEFINITION (can nguon thay the cho replyToRef).

2. THIET KE nguon du lieu moi cho replyToRef sau khi xoa relatedIds khoi release_task_definitions/
   emergency_release_task_definitions. Cac huong co the can nhac (Council tu de xuat them neu co huong
   khac hop ly hon):
   a. Them 1 truong MOI rieng bach tren definition, ten trung lap (vd `replyToDefinitionId` /
      "Tra loi vao bai cua muc nao"), UI la 1 dropdown chon 1 definition khac trong cung nhom (khong
      phai multi-select nhu relatedIds cu) - vi ban chat dung de chon DUNG 1 muc tieu reply, khong phai
      nhieu.
   b. Suy luan replyToRef tu 1 quy tac co dinh khac (vd luon reply vao definition dung truoc no theo
      thu tu sort_order/date_token) - CAN xac nhan qua doc code xem quy tac nay co dung voi MOI truong
      hop dang dung replyToRef that hay khong (doc toan bo call site dang dung origin_ref/reply_to_ref
      o ca release thuong lan khan cap de biet chinh xac nghiep vu that dang can gi).
   c. Phuong an khac neu Council thay hop ly hon sau khi doc code.

   PHAI doc toan bo noi dung server/routes/schedules.ts (noi tao task tu definition, dung origin_ref/
   reply_to_ref) va CA HAI luong Release thuong + Release khan cap trong src/screens/release.tsx truoc
   khi chon phuong an - day la nghiep vu that, khong duoc doan.

3. Liet ke CHINH XAC danh sach file/cho can sua (backend: schema, migration xoa cot, mappers,
   release-render.ts, routes lien quan; frontend: automation-fields.tsx, release.tsx, personal-task.tsx,
   i18n.ts, types.ts) va thu tu thuc hien an toan (vd: DB truoc hay FE truoc, co phu thuoc gi khong).

4. Xac dinh migration DB: dung LAI mau archive-roi-drop da co san (server/db-migrations.ts,
   `archiveAndDropAutomationSchema`) hay can 1 migration rieng - va ro cot nao thuc su bi drop
   (action_type, ai_note, related_ids tren 3 bang: tasks, release_task_definitions,
   emergency_release_task_definitions).

5. Xac nhan lai (bang chung code, khong doan) danh sach test hien co se bi anh huong (da grep so bo:
   test/client/components.test.tsx, test/unit/automation-schema-removal-migration*.test.ts,
   test/client/release-regular-create-error.test.tsx, test/unit/emergency-release-fixed-schedule.test.ts,
   test/unit/emergency-release-mention.test.ts, test/integration/tasks.test.ts,
   test/integration/schedules-release.test.ts, test/unit/release-render.test.ts) - test nao can sua,
   test nao can xoa hoan toan vi test hanh vi da khong con.

6. KHONG duoc tu sua code trong phien nay - day la phien thiet ke, ket qua la 1 ke hoach cu the de
   Claude Code tu thuc thi sau, roi mo 1 phien Council review rieng cho phan da sua.

7. Neu phat hien them rang buoc/rui ro nao khac ngoai 2 cai da neu (vd cho nao khac dang doc cac truong
   nay ma chua duoc liet ke), phai neu ro kem file:dong, khong duoc bo qua chi vi khong nam trong danh
   sach Leader da cho.
